function.name: create_project
function.description: Creates a new project in the PostgreSQL database. Use this when the user asks to create, initialize, save, or start a new project. The description should be a concise summary of the project's purpose and scope extracted from the user's request or conversation context.

name.description: The title or name of the project. Should be clear and descriptive.

description.description: The detailed project description. Always extract or synthesize this from the user's request. This is optional but highly recommended to capture the project's scope and goals.
